ideas: New tool: Anchor individual canvas objects
upgrades.summary: Implemented Anchor tool (⚓) — the final button in the existing object toolbar now selects a persistent per-object transform: tap a dynamic body to lock it in place with a pulsing cyan anchor marker, then tap it again to release it with restored motion, particle, sound, and haptic feedback; Clear and Eraser clean up Anchor state.

ideas: Feedback: Impact combo rewards
upgrades.summary: Implemented impact combo rewards — hard impacts above relative velocity 5 now chain into a short combo window, show a temporary combo and session-best HUD, add rising notes and extra confetti from 3x onward, and fire stronger milestone feedback at 5x, 10x, 20x, and 50x while Clear resets only the active streak.

ideas: Interaction: Balloon popping on hard impact
upgrades.summary: Implemented balloon popping — balloons now burst on hard non-static impacts above relative velocity 5 and when caught in bomb blasts, producing color-matched confetti, curling string remnants, pop sounds, haptic pulse, screen shake, destruction-meter credit, and cleanup of connected constraints/state.

ideas: UX: Desktop keyboard shortcuts
upgrades.summary: Implemented desktop keyboard shortcuts — number keys and mnemonic letters now select common tools, Shift+Space toggles slo-mo, Space pauses, Backspace clears, and single-letter keys trigger common chaos actions through the existing buttons with a short neon flash.

ideas: Visual: Slingshot trajectory preview
upgrades.summary: Implemented slingshot trajectory preview — drag launches now show 12 fading neon dots based on the same launch vector used on release plus current Matter.js gravity, making aimed shots easier to line up without changing physics or adding controls.

ideas: Visual: Collision heatmap overlay
upgrades.summary: Implemented collision heatmap overlay — energetic impacts now write into a coarse fading canvas grid that renders under objects as cyan, violet, and hot orange glow, making repeated chaos zones visibly accumulate while Clear resets the heat history.

ideas: UX: Eraser poof tool for selective cleanup
upgrades.summary: Implemented Eraser tool (🧹) — a new object toolbar tool that removes a tapped non-wall object with a poof particle burst, soft pop sounds, haptic pulse, and tiny screen nudge, while cleaning up connected constraints and feature tracking state so scenes can be refined without using Clear All.

ideas: Visual: Animated clear vortex drain
upgrades.summary: Implemented animated clear vortex drain — pressing Clear with scene objects now starts a 600ms cyan cleanup vortex that shrinks bodies, pulls dynamic objects toward center with a spiral force, plays a descending sweep, locks canvas input during cleanup, and then runs the existing reset. Empty clears and lesson loading still use the instant cleanup path.

ideas: Visual/audio: Destruction meter level-up celebration
upgrades.summary: Implemented destruction level-up celebration — when collision energy pushes the existing destruction meter into a higher rank, the app now fires color-matched confetti, a short center-screen level-up banner, screen shake, flash, and rising chimes, then resets the celebration state on Clear.

ideas: Sound: Musical collisions with pentatonic impact notes
upgrades.summary: Implemented musical collision notes — impact, bounce, and duck squeak sounds now draw from a shared C-major pentatonic scale by material and hit intensity, so busy collision chains layer into consonant generative audio while preserving the existing material sound character.

ideas: New object: Chain links that connect to nearby objects
upgrades.summary: Implemented Chain Link tool (🔗) — a new object button in the existing bottom toolbar that spawns small metal links, automatically connects each link to up to two nearby dynamic bodies with flexible Matter.js constraints, renders hollow cyan metal links and matching chain constraints, and clears all chain state on reset without changing the app layout.

ideas: Mobile: Haptic feedback for tactile actions
upgrades.summary: Implemented mobile haptic feedback — tactile vibration pulses now accompany bomb detonations, the explosion and quake buttons, black hole activation, gravity flips, mega bounce, scene clear, slingshot launches, and hard impacts, with collision pulses throttled and unsupported browsers silently ignoring the effect.

ideas: Visual: Spawn pop animation for newly placed objects
upgrades.summary: Implemented spawn pop animation — newly spawned bodies now get a 150ms visual scale-in from tiny to a slight overshoot before settling at full size, making placement feel punchier without changing physics or adding UI.

ideas: Visual: Tap ripple effect on every canvas press
upgrades.summary: Implemented tap ripples — every canvas click or touch now emits a color-matched expanding neon ring before the object spawns, making taps feel more responsive without changing physics or adding UI.

ideas: New object: Bouncy star shape with high restitution
New chaos button: Black hole — sucks everything toward center
Visual: Confetti burst when objects collide hard
upgrades.summary: Added bouncy star tool (⭐) with 0.95 restitution in random colors, Black Hole chaos button that sucks all objects to center for 5 seconds then flings them outward with a purple accretion disk visual, and confetti burst system that showers colorful tumbling confetti on hard impacts with screen shake.

ideas: New object: Balloon that floats upward with anti-gravity
New chaos button: Anti-gravity pulse — everything floats up briefly
Visual: Object trails/afterimages that fade
upgrades.summary: Added Balloon tool (🎈) that floats upward with buoyancy physics and gentle drift, with colorful oval rendering and swaying string. Anti-Gravity Pulse (FLOAT) chaos button reverses gravity for 4 seconds with sparkle particles and a satisfying drop when it ends. Speed trails system that renders glowing afterimages behind fast-moving objects for a slick motion-blur feel.

ideas: Interactive: Portals — two linked circles that teleport objects
New chaos button: Time warp — slow-motion toggle for 5 seconds
New chaos button: Rain — spawn 20 random small objects from the top
upgrades.summary: Added Portal tool (🌀) — tap twice to place a linked portal pair, objects entering one teleport out the other with exit particles and sound. Time Warp (SLO-MO) chaos button slows physics to 20% speed for 5 seconds with purple vortex overlay, vignette, and pulsing label. Rain chaos button (🌧️) drops 20 random objects from the sky in a staggered cascade for instant chaos.

ideas: Interactive: Pinball bumpers that light up on hit
New object: Beach ball — huge, light, super bouncy
New chaos button: Gravity flip — gravity rotates 90° each press
upgrades.summary: Added Pinball Bumpers (🔴) — place static bumpers that flash white and blast objects away on contact with particle bursts and satisfying pings. Beach Ball (🏖️) tool spawns huge, lightweight, super-bouncy balls with colorful striped panels and a glossy shine. Gravity Flip (G-FLIP) chaos button rotates gravity 90° each press (down→right→up→left) with a directional label flash and screen shake.

ideas: New object: Rubber duck that squeaks on impact
New chaos button: Mega bounce — temporarily max out all restitution
Easter egg: Konami code activates ultra-chaos mode
upgrades.summary: Added Rubber Duck tool (🦆) — yellow duck that squeaks on every impact with cute particles and custom sound. Mega Bounce (🏀) chaos button maxes all restitution to 1.2 for 5 seconds — everything becomes a super ball with green particle burst and timer bar. Konami Code easter egg (↑↑↓↓←→←→BA) triggers 10 seconds of ULTRA CHAOS — random explosions, object spawns, gravity nudges, screen-shaking rainbow tint, and a massive particle burst.

ideas: New object: Domino tile for chain reactions
New chaos button: Vortex — spins all objects around a center point
Visual: Lightning bolt between close fast-moving objects
upgrades.summary: Added Domino tile (🀄) — tall, thin tiles perfect for chain reactions with retro dot markings. Vortex (🌀) chaos button spins all objects around center with tangential force + inward pull for 5 seconds, purple swirl rings and particles. Lightning bolts — jagged electric arcs spark between nearby fast-moving objects with cyan glow, adding dramatic visual energy to high-speed chaos.

ideas: New chaos button: Tornado — funnel that moves across screen
New object: Anvil — extra heavy, smashes through everything
Visual: Fire trail on objects moving faster than threshold
upgrades.summary: Added Tornado (🌪️) chaos button — a funnel sweeps across the screen for 6 seconds, sucking objects upward and spinning them with debris particles. Anvil tool (🔨) spawns ultra-heavy anvils that smash through everything with satisfying weight. Fire trails blaze behind any object moving fast enough — yellow-to-red gradient flames that scale with speed.

ideas: Interactive: Trampoline platform with extra bounce
New chaos button: Freeze — all objects stop instantly then resume
Visual: Pixel dust cloud when objects land hard
upgrades.summary: Added Trampoline tool (🟩) — place static bounce pads that launch objects skyward with spring particles and a satisfying boing sound. Freeze (🧊) chaos button instantly freezes all objects in place for 3 seconds with ice crystal particles and blue frost overlay, then everything resumes with a dramatic thaw burst. Pixel dust clouds poof up when objects slam into walls/floor — brown/tan expanding puffs that add weight and impact to every hard landing.

ideas: Interactive: Conveyor belt surface that moves objects along it
Game mode: Popcorn — objects randomly pop upward every few seconds
Visual: Screen flash and chromatic aberration on big impacts
upgrades.summary: Added Conveyor Belt tool (⏩) — place static belts with animated chevrons that push objects left or right via surface friction. Popcorn (🍿) chaos button makes random objects pop upward for 8 seconds with butter-yellow particles and bounce sounds. Chromatic aberration — hard impacts and explosions now trigger RGB channel splitting and white screen flash for dramatic visual punch.

ideas: New object: Wrecking ball on a chain constraint
New chaos button: Shuffle — randomize all object positions
Game mode: Destruction meter — counts total energy released
upgrades.summary: Added Wrecking Ball tool (⚫) — heavy iron ball swinging on a chain from a static anchor point with metallic rendering and chain-link visuals. Shuffle (🔀) chaos button teleports every dynamic object to a random other object's position with orange burst particles, instant chaos. Destruction Meter HUD (bottom-left) tracks cumulative collision energy with 7 escalating ranks from CALM to GODLIKE, log-scale progress bar, and color-coded labels.

ideas: Interactive: Fan/blower that pushes objects with airflow
New object: Ice cube that's super slippery (low friction)
Easter egg: Triple-tap title for disco mode (flashing background colors)
upgrades.summary: Added Fan tool (💨) — place static blowers that push objects upward with visible wind particles and spinning blade animation. Ice Cube tool (🧊) — super slippery low-friction blocks with translucent icy rendering, internal cracks, and shine highlight. Disco Mode easter egg — triple-tap the title to toggle a disco ball with rotating spotlight beams, mirror tile sparkles, and rainbow particle rain.

ideas: Game mode: Target practice — spawn bullseyes worth points
New object: Magnet that attracts/repels nearby metal objects
Visual: Glow effect on fast-moving objects
upgrades.summary: Added Target Practice (🎯) chaos button — spawns 5 bullseye targets with concentric red/white circles, +10 points per hit with ding sound and particle explosions, CLEARED! bonus at 5/5, 15-second timer with score HUD. Magnet tool (🧲) — place static magnets that attract nearby objects within 150px, tap again to toggle repel mode, rendered with red/blue poles and curved magnetic field arcs. Speed Glow — objects moving fast get a pulsing radial gradient aura that shifts yellow→orange→red→white with increasing speed.

ideas: New object: Bowling pin that tips over satisfyingly
Interactive: Seesaw/teeter-totter you can place
Gravity: Underwater mode with buoyancy and drag
upgrades.summary: Added Bowling Pin tool (🎳) — tall narrow cream-white pins with red neck stripes that tip over satisfyingly with low density physics. Seesaw tool (⚖️) — place a wooden plank balanced on a triangle pivot via revolute constraint, perfect for launching objects by dropping heavy things on one end. Ocean Mode (🌊) toggle chaos button — reduces gravity to 30%, applies water drag to all bodies, spawns rising bubble particles with wobble, and adds a blue tint overlay for floaty underwater physics.

ideas: Game mode: Jenga tower — pre-built tower to knock down
Interactive: Rope/chain that connects two tap points
Visual: Object glow pulse on spawn (birth flash)
upgrades.summary: Added Jenga Tower (🏗️) chaos button — spawns 12 rows of alternating wooden blocks with ascending build sound, perfect for demolition. Rope tool (🪢) — select two objects to connect them with a sagging brown rope constraint, with knot dots and dashed selection indicator. Spawn Birth Flash — every new object appears with an expanding white ring and sparkle particles for a satisfying pop-in effect.

ideas: UX: Screenshot button that saves the canvas
upgrades.summary: Added Screenshot button (📸 SNAP) to chaos bar — captures the canvas as PNG with timestamped filename, includes white camera flash effect overlay, shutter sound effect, and on-screen 'Screenshot saved!' notification that fades out. Perfect for sharing chaotic masterpieces!

ideas: Sound: Material-based impact sounds (metal clang, rubber boing, wood thud)
upgrades.summary: Implemented material-based collision audio system — every object now has a material property (metal, rubber, wood, plastic, glass/ice) that determines its impact sound. Metal objects clang with high-pitched rings, rubber boings with bouncy tones, wood thunks with hollow percussive hits, glass/ice tings with crystalline chimes, and plastic taps with light clicks. Sounds scale with impact intensity for highly satisfying physics feedback!

ideas: Sound: Whoosh sound on slingshot launch scaled to power
upgrades.summary: Added power-scaled whoosh sound on slingshot launches — uses sawtooth wave with frequency sweep from 80-600Hz, duration 0.15-0.3s, and volume 0.08-0.16, all scaled to launch power (0-25). Weak launches get subtle low whooshes, max-power launches get satisfying high-pitched swooshes. Adds crucial audio feedback to the core slingshot mechanic!

ideas: Sound: Background ambient hum that reacts to chaos level
upgrades.summary: Implemented dynamic background ambient hum that responds to destruction meter in real-time. Dual-oscillator system (sine + triangle) creates a rich, evolving soundscape. Frequency ranges from 40Hz (CALM) to 120Hz (GODLIKE), volume scales from 0.015 to 0.08 based on chaos level. Toggle button in chaos bar (🔊 AMBIENT) controls playback. Audio automatically adjusts pitch and intensity as physics mayhem escalates — adds atmospheric depth and subconscious feedback to the chaos!
